Q08.question: Did my July sale actually work?

first_plan.objective: Determine whether the July sale worked by evaluating promotional timing, baseline vs. sale vs. post-sale performance across revenue and gross profit, customer mix (new vs. existing), and discount costs according to the brand's promotion analysis settings.
success_criteria: Identify the exact July sale promotion details (code, start_date, end_date, discount_pct).
Calculate baseline, sale, and post-sale (14-day, 28-day, and brand cadence/42-day) metrics: net revenue, gross profit, realized margin, orders, AOV, per-day rates, and percentage lifts.
Calculate combined-window performance (sale + post-sale vs. baseline) to evaluate pull-forward effects.
Analyze customer mix (existing vs. new buyers during the sale) and discount cost incurred.
Check compliance with brand discount policies (max 20% regular, max 25% sitewide, no more than 2 sitewide sales/year).

input.sql: SELECT promo_code, description, start_date, end_date, discount_pct, (end_date - start_date + 1) AS sale_days FROM public.promotions WHERE (start_date >= '2025-07-01' AND start_date <= '2025-07-31') OR promo_code ILIKE '%july%' ORDER BY start_date;

WITH promo AS (
  SELECT '2025-07-11'::date AS sale_start, '2025-07-20'::date AS sale_end
),
windows AS (
  SELECT
    'Baseline' AS window_name,
    1 AS sort_order,
    (sale_start - INTERVAL '30 days')::date AS start_date,
    (sale_start - INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS end_date,
    30 AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Sale' AS window_name,
    2 AS sort_order,
    sale_start AS start_date,
    sale_end AS end_date,
    (sale_end - sale_start + 1) AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Post-Sale 14d' AS window_name,
    3 AS sort_order,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '14 days')::date AS end_date,
    14 AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Post-Sale 28d' AS window_name,
    4 AS sort_order,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '28 days')::date AS end_date,
    28 AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Post-Sale 42d' AS window_name,
    5 AS sort_order,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '42 days')::date AS end_date,
    42 AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Sale + Post-Sale 14d' AS window_name,
    6 AS sort_order,
    sale_start AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '14 days')::date AS end_date,
    (sale_end - sale_start + 1 + 14) AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Sale + Post-Sale 28d' AS window_name,
    7 AS sort_order,
    sale_start AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '28 days')::date AS end_date,
    (sale_end - sale_start + 1 + 28) AS day_count
  FROM promo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Sale + Post-Sale 42d' AS window_name,
    8 AS sort_order,
    sale_start AS start_date,
    (sale_end + INTERVAL '42 days')::date AS end_date,
    (sale_end - sale_start + 1 + 42) AS day_count
  FROM promo
),
delivered_lines AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price,
    p.unit_cost,
    p.list_price,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_net_revenue,
    (oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS line_cost,
    (oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS line_gross_profit,
    (oi.quantity * (p.list_price - oi.unit_price)) AS line_discount_cost
  FROM public.orders o
  JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE c.is_internal = false
    AND o.status = 'delivered'
),
window_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    w.window_name,
    w.sort_order,
    w.start_date,
    w.end_date,
    w.day_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dl.order_id) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_net_revenue), 0) AS total_net_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_gross_profit), 0) AS total_gross_profit,
    COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_discount_cost), 0) AS total_discount_cost,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT dl.order_id)::numeric / w.day_count, 2) AS orders_per_day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_net_revenue), 0)::numeric / w.day_count, 2) AS net_revenue_per_day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_gross_profit), 0)::numeric / w.day_count, 2) AS gross_profit_per_day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_discount_cost), 0)::numeric / w.day_count, 2) AS discount_cost_per_day,
    CASE 
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dl.order_id) > 0 
      THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_net_revenue), 0)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT dl.order_id), 2)
      ELSE 0 
    END AS aov,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_net_revenue), 0) > 0 
      THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(dl.line_gross_profit), 0)::numeric / SUM(dl.line_net_revenue)) * 100, 2)
      ELSE 0 
    END AS realized_margin_pct
  FROM windows w
  LEFT JOIN delivered_lines dl ON dl.order_date BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date
  GROUP BY w.window_name, w.sort_order, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.day_count
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT * FROM window_metrics WHERE window_name = 'Baseline'
)
SELECT
  wm.window_name,
  wm.start_date,
  wm.end_date,
  wm.day_count,
  wm.total_orders,
  wm.total_net_revenue,
  wm.total_gross_profit,
  wm.total_discount_cost,
  wm.orders_per_day,
  wm.net_revenue_per_day,
  wm.gross_profit_per_day,
  wm.discount_cost_per_day,
  wm.aov,
  wm.realized_margin_pct,
  -- Per-day lifts vs baseline
  ROUND(wm.orders_per_day - b.orders_per_day, 2) AS orders_per_day_diff,
  ROUND(((wm.orders_per_day - b.orders_per_day) / b.orders_per_day) * 100, 2) AS orders_per_day_lift_pct,
  ROUND(wm.net_revenue_per_day - b.net_revenue_per_day, 2) AS net_revenue_per_day_diff,
  ROUND(((wm.net_revenue_per_day - b.net_revenue_per_day) / b.net_revenue_per_day) * 100, 2) AS net_revenue_lift_pct,
  ROUND(wm.gross_profit_per_day - b.gross_profit_per_day, 2) AS gross_profit_per_day_diff,
  ROUND(((wm.gross_profit_per_day - b.gross_profit_per_day) / b.gross_profit_per_day) * 100, 2) AS gross_profit_lift_pct,
  -- Window total lifts vs baseline expected total (per_day * day_count)
  ROUND(wm.total_net_revenue - (b.net_revenue_per_day * wm.day_count), 2) AS incremental_net_revenue,
  ROUND(wm.total_gross_profit - (b.gross_profit_per_day * wm.day_count), 2) AS incremental_gross_profit
FROM window_metrics wm
CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY wm.sort_order;

WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_internal = false
      AND o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
sale_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN fo.first_order_date < '2025-07-11' THEN 'existing'
            ELSE 'new'
        END AS customer_type,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_net_revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS order_cogs,
        SUM(oi.quantity * (p.list_price - oi.unit_price)) AS order_discount_cost
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN first_orders fo ON o.customer_id = fo.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_internal = false
      AND o.status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-11' AND '2025-07-20'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, customer_type
),
sale_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, customer_type
    FROM sale_orders
),
post_sale_repeats AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.customer_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS total_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END) AS repeat_customers,
        COUNT(po.order_id) AS post_sale_repeat_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity * poi.unit_price), 0) AS post_sale_net_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity * (poi.unit_price - p.unit_cost)), 0) AS post_sale_gross_profit
    FROM sale_customers sc
    LEFT JOIN public.orders po 
        ON sc.customer_id = po.customer_id 
        AND po.order_date > '2025-07-20' 
        AND po.status = 'delivered'
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items poi ON po.order_id = poi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN public.products p ON poi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY sc.customer_type
)
SELECT 
    so.customer_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT so.customer_id)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT so.customer_id)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS buyer_share_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.order_id) AS order_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT so.order_id)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT so.order_id)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS order_share_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(so.order_net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(so.order_net_revenue) / SUM(SUM(so.order_net_revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(so.order_net_revenue - so.order_cogs), 2) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND((SUM(so.order_net_revenue - so.order_cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(so.order_net_revenue), 0)) * 100, 2) AS realized_margin_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(so.order_discount_cost), 2) AS discount_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(so.order_net_revenue), 2) AS aov,
    psr.repeat_customers,
    ROUND(psr.repeat_customers::numeric / NULLIF(psr.total_customers, 0) * 100, 2) AS repeat_rate_pct,
    ROUND(psr.post_sale_net_revenue, 2) AS post_sale_revenue,
    ROUND(psr.post_sale_gross_profit, 2) AS post_sale_gross_profit
FROM sale_orders so
JOIN post_sale_repeats psr ON so.customer_type = psr.customer_type
GROUP BY so.customer_type, psr.repeat_customers, psr.total_customers, psr.post_sale_net_revenue, psr.post_sale_gross_profit;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_buyers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_net_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS total_gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (p.list_price - oi.unit_price)), 2) AS total_discount_cost,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS total_aov
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.is_internal = false
  AND o.status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-11' AND '2025-07-20';

raw_report_call.summary: The July SUMMER25 promotion (2025-07-11 to 2025-07-20) generated positive net revenue and gross profit lift, but at a substantial discount cost and with significant customer cannibalization. During the 10-day sale, net revenue per day increased by 123.28% (to 9688.41 per day from a 4339.11 baseline) and gross profit per day increased by 75.75% (to 4372.21 per day from a 2487.71 baseline), generating 96884.10 in net revenue and 43722.10 in gross profit across 1127 orders. However, realized margin dropped from 57.33% to 45.13% due to a total discount cost of 29927.90. In the post-sale periods, volume dipped below baseline across all monitored horizons: net revenue per day fell by -4.51% over 14 days, -8.73% over 28 days, and -7.06% over 42 days, while gross profit per day dropped by -4.53% (14d), -8.52% (28d), and -6.92% (42d). Across the full combined Sale + Post-Sale 42d window, the promotion remained cumulatively positive, delivering 40620.23 in incremental net revenue and 11611.03 in incremental gross profit. Crucially, 78.98% of buyers (793 of 1004) and 81.55% of promotional revenue (79005.65) came from existing customers, absorbing 24485.35 of total discounts, whereas new customers represented 211 buyers generating 17878.45 in revenue with 130 repeat buyers post-sale (61.61% repeat rate). Assumptions: Baseline window of 30 days (2025-06-11 to 2025-07-10) and post-sale evaluation window of 42 days (2025-07-21 to 2025-08-31) were sourced from brand analysis_settings; 14-day and 28-day post-sale windows were included per methodology standards.
actions: Evaluate whether sitewide discounting should be replaced or limited with minimum spend thresholds, given that existing customers captured 79005.65 of the 96884.10 promotional revenue.
Structure future promotional campaigns to acquire new customers rather than discounting existing customer volume, noting that new customers had a 61.61 repeat rate following the sale.
Monitor ongoing margin and repeat ordering cadence to verify if demand pull-forward causes prolonged deficits after post-sale day 42.
cannot_determine: Whether the post-sale volume dip represents temporary demand pull-forward or permanent customer habituation cannot be definitively determined without longer-term cohort tracking.
Competitor promotional activity and market price benchmarks during the July 11 to July 20 period were not collected and cannot be analyzed.

findings.claim: The July promotion ran under code SUMMER25 as a site-wide sale from 2025-07-11 to 2025-07-20 (10 days) offering a 25.00 percent discount.

During the 10-day sale window, delivered orders reached 1127 generating 96884.10 in net revenue and 43722.10 in gross profit, with orders per day lifting by 175.55 percent, net revenue per day lifting by 123.28 percent, and gross profit per day lifting by 75.75 percent relative to the 30-day baseline.
The promotion incurred a total discount cost of 29927.90 during the 10 sale days, reducing realized margin to 45.13 percent compared to 57.33 percent in the baseline period.

Across all three post-sale evaluation windows, performance experienced a dip relative to baseline: 14-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -4.51 percent and gross profit per day fell by -4.53 percent; 28-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -8.73 percent and gross profit per day fell by -8.52 percent; and 42-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -7.06 percent and gross profit per day fell by -6.92 percent.

When accounting for post-sale performance, the combined Sale + Post-Sale 14d window delivered incremental net revenue of 50754.71 and incremental gross profit of 17267.31; the combined Sale + Post-Sale 28d window delivered incremental net revenue of 42885.87 and incremental gross profit of 12912.07; and the combined Sale + Post-Sale 42d window delivered incremental net revenue of 40620.23 and incremental gross profit of 11611.03.

Out of 1004 total buyers and 1127 total delivered orders during the sale, existing customers accounted for 793 buyers (78.98 percent) and 899 orders (79.77 percent), generating 79005.65 in net revenue (81.55 percent share) and absorbing 24485.35 of the discount cost.

New customers during the sale totaled 211 buyers (21.02 percent share) and 228 orders (20.23 percent share), producing 17878.45 in net revenue (18.45 percent share) with 5442.55 in discount cost, of whom 130 customers repeated post-sale (a 61.61 percent repeat rate).

Assumptions: Baseline window of 30 days (2025-06-11 to 2025-07-10) and post-sale evaluation window of 42 days (2025-07-21 to 2025-08-31) were sourced from brand analysis_settings; 14-day and 28-day post-sale windows were included per methodology standards.

findings.claim: The July promotion ran under code SUMMER25 as a site-wide sale from 2025-07-11 to 2025-07-20 (10 days) offering a 25.00 percent discount.

During the 10-day sale window, delivered orders reached 1127 generating 96884.10 in net revenue and 43722.10 in gross profit, with orders per day lifting by 175.55 percent, net revenue per day lifting by 123.28 percent, and gross profit per day lifting by 75.75 percent relative to the 30-day baseline.
The promotion incurred a total discount cost of 29927.90 during the 10 sale days, reducing realized margin to 45.13 percent compared to 57.33 percent in the baseline period.

Across all three post-sale evaluation windows, performance experienced a dip relative to baseline: 14-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -4.51 percent and gross profit per day fell by -4.53 percent; 28-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -8.73 percent and gross profit per day fell by -8.52 percent; and 42-day post-sale net revenue per day fell by -7.06 percent and gross profit per day fell by -6.92 percent.

When accounting for post-sale performance, the combined Sale + Post-Sale 14d window delivered incremental net revenue of 50754.71 and incremental gross profit of 17267.31; the combined Sale + Post-Sale 28d window delivered incremental net revenue of 42885.87 and incremental gross profit of 12912.07; and the combined Sale + Post-Sale 42d window delivered incremental net revenue of 40620.23 and incremental gross profit of 11611.03.

Out of 1004 total buyers and 1127 total delivered orders during the sale, existing customers accounted for 793 buyers (78.98 percent) and 899 orders (79.77 percent), generating 79005.65 in net revenue (81.55 percent share) and absorbing 24485.35 of the discount cost.

New customers during the sale totaled 211 buyers (21.02 percent share) and 228 orders (20.23 percent share), producing 17878.45 in net revenue (18.45 percent share) with 5442.55 in discount cost, of whom 130 customers repeated post-sale (a 61.61 percent repeat rate).

actions: Evaluate whether sitewide discounting should be replaced or limited with minimum spend thresholds, given that existing customers captured 79005.65 of the 96884.10 promotional revenue.
Structure future promotional campaigns to acquire new customers rather than discounting existing customer volume, noting that new customers had a 61.61 repeat rate following the sale.
Monitor ongoing margin and repeat ordering cadence to verify if demand pull-forward causes prolonged deficits after post-sale day 42.
cannot_determine: Whether the post-sale volume dip represents temporary demand pull-forward or permanent customer habituation cannot be definitively determined without longer-term cohort tracking.
Competitor promotional activity and market price benchmarks during the July 11 to July 20 period were not collected and cannot be analyzed.
